comment: sit.c throne_sit_effect() 107-109, 148-150 and 175-178. On Friday 13 November 2037 (Luck -1) a debug Priestess wishes a throne and sits, choosing effect 6 at the wizard-mode prompt until 'You feel your luck is changing' (Luck + rn2(5) < 0; the other tries grant a wish, answered 'nothing'), which brings Luck to 0. She walks away from a lichen, polymorphs into an eyeless gray ooze (so Blind), wishes another throne and chooses effect 10: with Luck 0 and no intrinsic see invisible, eyecount() is 0 and 'You have a very strange feeling in your cerebral area' prints, granting see invisible. She level-teleports to the nommap Valley of the Dead, wishes a third throne and chooses effect 10 again: the intrinsic now sends her to the nommap branch, 'A terrible drone fills your head!'. Analyze-throne prompts are answered ESC; a Valley monster's killing blow is refused at Die?.
